Pembentukan Variabel Y dan X¶

In [5]:
# LOG RETURN
log_return = np.log(
    ptro['Close'] / ptro['Close'].shift(1)
)

# VOLATILITY t
std_t = log_return.rolling(window=21).std()

# VOLATILITY t+1
std_t1 = std_t.shift(-1)

# Merge
Data = pd.concat(
    [
        log_return,
        std_t,
        std_t1
    ],
    axis=1
)


Data.columns = [
    'X_lr',
    'X_stdt',
    'Y'
]

Data = Data.dropna()

Fitting Distribusi¶

In [6]:
Y = Data['Y'].dropna()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# =====================================
# TARGET VARIABLE
# =====================================

Y = Data['Y'].dropna()

# =====================================
# DISTRIBUTIONS
# =====================================

distributions = {
    'Normal': stats.norm,
    'Lognormal': stats.lognorm,
    'Gamma': stats.gamma,
    'Weibull': stats.weibull_min,
    'Exponential': stats.expon
}

results = []

# =====================================
# FIT DISTRIBUTIONS
# =====================================

for name, dist in distributions.items():

    params = dist.fit(Y)

    ks_stat, p_value = stats.kstest(
        Y,
        dist.name,
        args=params
    )

    results.append({
        'Distribution': name,
        'KS Statistic': ks_stat,
        'P-Value': p_value
    })

# =====================================
# RESULT
# =====================================

result_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

result_df = result_df.sort_values(
    by='KS Statistic'
)

display(result_df)

Splitting Data¶

In [8]:
n = len(Data)

train_size = int(n * 0.8)
val_size   = int(n * 0.1)

# TRAIN
data_train = Data.iloc[:train_size]

# VALIDATION
data_val = Data.iloc[
    train_size : train_size + val_size
]

# TEST
data_test = Data.iloc[
    train_size + val_size :
]

Sequence Function¶

In [16]:
def create_sequences(X, Y, time_steps):

    Xs, Ys = [], []

    for i in range(len(X) - time_steps):

        Xs.append(
            X.iloc[i:(i + time_steps)].values
        )

        Ys.append(
            Y.iloc[i + time_steps]
        )

    return np.array(Xs), np.array(Ys)

In [36]:
# =====================================================
# FORECAST VOLATILITY t+1
# =====================================================

# Ambil 21 observasi terakhir dari seluruh data scaled

last_sequence = Data[
    ['X_lr', 'X_stdt']
]

last_sequence_scaled = pd.DataFrame(

    scaler.transform(
        Data[['X_lr', 'X_stdt', 'Y']]
    ),

    index=Data.index,
    columns=Data.columns

)[['X_lr', 'X_stdt']]

# 21 hari terakhir

X_forecast = last_sequence_scaled.tail(
    time_steps
).values

X_forecast = X_forecast.reshape(
    1,
    time_steps,
    2
)

# Prediksi t+1

pred_t1_scaled = model.predict(
    X_forecast,
    verbose=0
)

print(
    "Prediksi Volatilitas t+1 (scaled):",
    pred_t1_scaled[0][0]
)



# =====================================================
# INVERSE TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

dummy = np.zeros(
    (1,3)
)

dummy[0,2] = pred_t1_scaled[0][0]

pred_t1 = scaler.inverse_transform(
    dummy
)[0,2]

print(
    "Prediksi Volatilitas t+1:",
    pred_t1
)

Prediksi Volatilitas t+1 (scaled): 0.8128464
Prediksi Volatilitas t+1: 0.06847354127196265
In [37]:

    'X_stdt'
].iloc[-1]

    "Latest Volatility :",

)

print(
    "Forecast t+1      :",
    pred_t1
)

print(
    "Change (%)        :",
    (
        (pred_t1 - latest_volatility)
        /
        latest_volatility
    ) * 100
)
